consistency_duration_tolerance: max(1/32 quarter, 20% of XML tied duration)
missing_files: Only their published points are lost. Missing/unparseable MusicXML supplies zero notes; missing/invalid MIDI without alignment.json also prevents wall-clock mapping. Missing/invalid PDF gives notation_review=0. No score caps.
manual_review: One independent reviewer; unreviewed existing PDF => null, pending 10. Layout and notation semantics must be examined, never inferred from existence. No final score until resolved.
